OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t, date_diff('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), DATE '2026-10-14') AS age
WHERE age <= 78

   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  DATE_PART('year', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) - DATE_PART('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE))
  - CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) < DATE_PART('month', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE))
      OR (DATE_PART('month', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) = DATE_PART('month', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE))
          AND DATE_PART('day', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) < DATE_PART('day', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE)))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
